header.name: [bedrock-research]actor-portrait-rp_v1.1.0
header.description: v1.1.0 - HUD panel from the title factory with four actor_portrait_renderer cells. Each cell picks its actor_id from 32 candidate player ids with variables whose requires compare the subtitle, and sets rotate_mode auto, scale_x/y/z with rotate_y, or rotate_x.
